card: H-20261026-01 infrastructure prerequisite, not new mathematical evidence
purpose: Replace an inaccurate generic cumulative-process CPU claim with an enforced single Python worker contract for the planned pure-Python falsifier.
worker_process_group: exactly one worker process; all its threads share kernel RLIMIT_CPU; process creation/exec is rejected by audit hook for cooperative frozen workers
supported: reviewed pure Python scripts without subprocess/native escape; not a security sandbox and not a general lake/Lean process-tree runner
acceptance: exact os.wait4 CPU for normal/CPU-killed/wall-killed runs; threads counted; fork/exec attempts rejected; group absent after completion; controller overhead reported separately
stop: any unsupported child creation or missing CPU measurement -> no mathematical CPU search, retain budget0 and work on paper
accounting: group CPU equals worker CPU under this no-descendants contract. Do not claim generic process-tree accounting or add CPU to journal. Freeze each math worker source, argv, discovery/holdout and revision before execution.
